arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/leads-bootstrap-docs-verify.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 --branch docs/bootstrap-single-source-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
echo CHECKED_SHA $(git rev-parse HEAD)
git -c credential.helper= fetch -q --depth 20 origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
git diff --check origin/main HEAD
echo CHANGED_FILES
git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
files=['AGENTS.md','docs/BOOTSTRAP.md','docs/PROJECT-STATE.md',
       'docs/README.md','docs/PUBLIC_GROUP_DISCOVERY.md',
       'docs/OPERATIONS_AND_REVIEW.md','docs/OWNER-PROTOCOL-20261019.md']
for name in files:
 txt=Path(name).read_text()
 assert txt.strip(),f'{name}:empty'
 assert 'BOOTSTRAP.md' in txt,f'{name}:bootstrap_reference_missing'
 print('DOC_LINK_OK',name)
boot=Path('docs/BOOTSTRAP.md').read_text()
assert 'PT_ES' in boot and 'EU_OTHER' in boot
assert 'um grupo por dia' in boot
assert '(conta, grupo)' in boot
state=Path('docs/PROJECT-STATE.md').read_text()
assert 'Deploy e ensaio real desta revisão continuam pendentes' in state
print('DOC_CONTRACT_PASS')
PY
sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
echo DOCS_TESTS_COMPLETE
